summary: A recurring free 'Second Saturdays' night at Afterglow AVL (95 Roberts St, in The Radical Hotel), self-described as 'FOMO Frequencies,' an 'evolving ecosystem of DJs and visual artists creating in individual and collective motion' pairing DJ sets with synchronized light/audiovisual art. Only 2 listings exist (Dec 2025, Jan 2026) with identical boilerplate copy, no named DJs, artists, or organizers, and no discoverable independent web presence.

evidence.note: Listing describes it as 'an Asheville-based evolving ecosystem of DJs and visual artists, creating in individual and collective motion,' explicitly framing it as a collective rather than a single host, but names no individuals.

Explore Asheville's own tags on the listing include 'Audiovisual Collective' and 'Second Saturdays', a third-party categorization as a recurring collective series rather than a one-off show, but structurally it's just a monthly DJ/light-art night at one bar.

No membership language: no mention of joining, dues, a roster, or a Facebook/Meetup/Discord group; both event descriptions are near-identical marketing copy for the night, not a group's self-description.
Fetched the Radical Hotel's page for 'after/glow' (the venue, formerly 'Afterglow AVL'); it makes no mention of FOMO Collective/Frequencies at all.

Attempted fetch of a plausible Facebook page and Instagram (@fomofrequencies); both returned no readable bio/about content, and a dedicated fomofrequencies.com domain does not resolve, so no independent group presence could be confirmed.
